rationale.text: Two elements share the id titre, but the page has no doctype. The test applies for each document type declaration, and the DOM cannot show whether the source held a declaration that the parser dropped. The custom check answers cannot_tell when there is no doctype node (step 1); only the record supports this branch. The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, alternative_unresolved at full.
